lines.text: Hello everyone, welcome to the Exeunt demo.
Exeunt is an exit market for frozen lending pools, on Arbitrum and Robinhood Chain.
When borrowers take all of a pool's liquidity, depositors cannot withdraw, sometimes for days.
Exeunt lets them sell their stuck deposit to borrowers, bidders or a shared vault, and get paid right away.
And it does that without taking any liquidity out of the pool.
For this demo, we use the web app at exeunt.space, on the Kelp replay network.
It is a fork of Arbitrum One on 18 April 2026, the day the Aave WETH pool hit 100% utilization.
lines.say: It is a fork of Arbitrum One on the eighteenth of April, twenty twenty-six, the day the Aave WETH pool hit one hundred percent utilization.

lines.text: It runs against Aave's real contracts and real state.
I have prepared two browser profiles, both using the built-in demo wallet.
Alice is a depositor, with 10 WETH stuck in the pool.
lines.say: Alice is a depositor, with ten WETH stuck in the pool.

lines.text: Bob borrowed 5 WETH against USDC, and also holds spare WETH and stablecoins to bid with.
lines.say: Bob borrowed five WETH against USDC, and also holds spare WETH and stablecoins to bid with.

lines.text: Their positions come from the faucet on this fork, and anyone can get the same with one click.
This is the Overview.
Every pool shows its exit capacity, read straight from the chain.
Utilization is at 100%, and nothing is withdrawable.
lines.say: Utilization is at one hundred percent, and nothing is withdrawable.

lines.text: But borrowers of the same asset owe nearly 150,000 WETH, far more than what is stuck.
lines.say: But borrowers of the same asset owe nearly one hundred fifty thousand WETH, far more than what is stuck.

lines.text: And that debt is where the exit comes from.
Curators can also set an alert here, and get a signed webhook when utilization crosses their threshold.
Alice wants out.
She could sell into standing bids right away, but first she runs a Dutch auction, so she gives away only as much discount as she must.
It starts at 0.5%, rises by 0.25% every 15 minutes up to 5%, and it never goes back down.
lines.say: It starts at half a percent, rises by a quarter of a percent every fifteen minutes up to five percent, and it never goes back down.

lines.text: By default she accepts any of the market's payment assets: USDG, USDC, WETH and wstETH.
lines.say: By default she accepts any of the market's payment assets: USDG, USDC, WETH, and wrapped staked ETH.

lines.text: She enters 4 WETH, and opens the auction.
lines.say: She enters four WETH, and opens the auction.

lines.text: Her receipts are held in escrow, and she can take back the unsold part at any time.
Bob owes 5 WETH.
lines.say: Bob owes five WETH.

lines.text: On the Buy page he sees Alice's auction, and buys 1 WETH of her receipts, paying in USDG.
lines.say: On the Buy page he sees Alice's auction, and buys one WETH of her receipts, paying in USDG.

lines.text: Before anything is sent, the panel shows what he pays, and what he saves.
In one transaction, Exeunt flash-borrows WETH, repays 1 WETH of Bob's debt, uses that new liquidity to redeem Alice's receipts, and returns the loan.
lines.say: In one transaction, Exeunt flash-borrows WETH, repays one WETH of Bob's debt, uses that new liquidity to redeem Alice's receipts, and returns the loan.

lines.text: Bob's debt drops by 1 WETH, and he pays half a percent less.
lines.say: Bob's debt drops by one WETH, and he pays half a percent less.

lines.text: Alice is paid at once, and the pool's withdrawable liquidity is exactly what it was before.
What if a borrower has no cash?
With flash mode, Bob pays with his collateral instead.
The market repays his debt first, which frees part of his USDC collateral, and that collateral pays Alice.
lines.say: The market repays his debt first, which frees part of his USDC collateral, and that collateral pays Alice.

lines.text: Bob needs nothing up front, and his health factor can only go up: if it would go down, the transaction reverts.
One click runs the one-time approval, then the purchase.
His debt goes from 4 to 3 WETH.
lines.say: His debt goes from four to three WETH.

lines.text: Not every buyer borrows.
Treasuries and market makers can post limit bids before any freeze: they escrow the funds, and set the minimum discount they accept.
Only escrowed funds count, every bid is public, and a bid can be cancelled at any time.
For passive capital, there is the Exeunt Vault.
You deposit once, and the vault bids by rules fixed at deployment.
At least a 3% discount, and at most 20% of its capital per receipt.
lines.say: At least a three percent discount, and at most twenty percent of its capital per receipt.

lines.text: Its capital stays out of the pool it protects.
When the pool refills, anyone can trigger its recovery, and the discount becomes the depositors' profit.
Depositors can leave at any time.
Back to Alice.
She does not want to wait for the auction any more, so she sells 3 WETH now.
lines.say: She does not want to wait for the auction any more, so she sells three WETH now.

lines.text: The preview fills the smallest discounts first, across limit bids and the vault.
Each bid pays from its own escrow, in its own asset, and she is paid in the same transaction.
Bob bought 2 of the 4 WETH in Alice's auction.
lines.say: Bob bought two of the four WETH in Alice's auction.

lines.text: She can take back the other two whenever she wants, with no waiting period; what already sold stays sold.
One more case: Aave borrowers whose collateral is the frozen asset.
They cannot withdraw it, so they cannot use it to repay debt, or move it.
This page first checks whether a direct withdrawal works.
When it is blocked, Exeunt sells the collateral into escrowed bids to repay debt, or swaps it for new collateral, in a single transaction.
The same exit works on Robinhood Chain, an Arbitrum Orbit chain, for Morpho Earn vaults, with Paxos USDG as the main payment asset.
lines.say: The same exit works on Robinhood Chain, an Arbitrum Orbit chain, for Morpho Earn vaults, with Paxos USDG as the main payment asset.

lines.text: This is the Earn bank-run network: a fork of Robinhood Chain where the Steakhouse USDG vault was drained.
lines.say: This is the Earn bank-run network: a fork of Robinhood Chain where the Steakhouse USDG vault was drained.

lines.text: Same pages, same flows.
On Morpho, flash mode uses a signed authorization instead of an approval, and revokes it in the same transaction.
Everything you saw is also open to other apps, and to AI agents.
On-chain reads, a TypeScript SDK, webhooks, and an MCP server with 18 tools.
lines.say: On-chain reads, a TypeScript SDK, webhooks, and an MCP server with eighteen tools.

lines.text: The MCP server never holds keys: it returns unsigned transactions, and the user's or the agent's wallet signs them.
lines.say: The MCP server never holds keys: it returns unsigned transactions, and the user's or the agent's wallet signs them.

lines.text: Here, an MCP client asks for the exit capacity of the Kelp replay pool, and gets it straight from the chain.
lines.say: Here, an MCP client asks for the exit capacity of the Kelp replay pool, and gets it straight from the chain.

lines.text: That's all for our demo.
With Exeunt, a frozen pool no longer means a locked exit.
Thanks for watching!
